changes.title: Google Kubernetes Engine: Feature (November 12, 2026)
changes.detail: Agent Sandbox on GKE is generally available and runs on any supported GKE version. Agent Sandbox on GKE is optimized for running isolated, stateful, single-replica workloads, such as AI agents, at no additional cost. You can install Agent Sandbox on GKE by using the open source Agent Sandbox installation . For more information, see About Agent Sandbox on GKE and Install Agent Sandbox on GKE .

changes.title: Google Kubernetes Engine: Feature (November 12, 2026)
changes.detail: Agent Gateway for GKE is now available in Preview in the Rapid channel on clusters running GKE version 1.37.2-gke.1042000 or later. Agent Gateway provides a centralized management layer to control traffic flowing to, from, and between your agents on GKE. This feature is supported in the following regions: europe-west1 us-central1 For more information, see Agent Gateway for GKE .
